name: Apple Music Student
summary: Apple Music at a student price, with Apple TV included.
key: A$7.99 a month, first month free for new subscribers. Includes Apple TV.
who: Verified university students who are new Apple Music subscribers.
how: Choose the Student plan in Apple Music and verify your student status.
catches: Student pricing lasts up to four years while you stay a student, then moves to A$14.99 a month.
Apple TV access ends when you no longer qualify.
Can't be shared with a Family Sharing group.
